Class AvlTree.Set<K extends Comparable<K>>

java.lang.Object
org.conetex.runtime.instrument.collection.AvlTree.Set<K>
Type Parameters:

All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public static class AvlTree.Set<K extends Comparable<K>> extends Object implements Iterable<K>
A set backed by an AVL tree. Elements are stored as keys; duplicates replace existing entries.

  • Constructor Details

    • Set

      public Set()
      Creates a new, empty AvlTree-backed set.

      The constructed set is initially empty and ready to accept elements via insertIntoTree(K). Elements are ordered by their natural ordering (keys must implement Comparable).

      Note: this constructor runs in constant time and performs no I/O. The set's instance methods use internal synchronization for concurrent access; callers should apply external synchronization if they require atomicity across multiple operations.
